description: This file defines a Validator class responsible for validating input values against a set of rules within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for validating parameters, handling exceptions, and filtering necessary values.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class providing static methods for validating input data against defined rules, handling exceptions, and filtering necessary values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an array of values against a set of rules, throws exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: getOnlyNecessaryValues
methods.description: Filters the input values to include only those necessary based on the rules, excluding specified keys.
